lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit. At least four horizontal rows are discernible, with the highest-intensity clusters located in the second and third rows from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a characteristic grid pattern across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with a bright superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a low density of approximately 6-8 indistinct, low-contrast high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily near the base and along the anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, approximately mid-way between the apex and the base.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible beneath the ventral surface and near the pectoral fin; the pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, distinct high-luminance spots on its dorsal surface.
